name: noacg-studio
description: NoaCG Studio's Claude Code plugins: make broadcast graphics for NoaCG from a coding agent, validate them the way NoaCG does, and save them into your NoaCG library.

plugins.name: noacg
plugins.description: The plugin entrance to the NoaCG CLI: the noacg-graphic skill (the NoaCG contract, the tools, the loop) and the /noacg:graphic command - make a broadcast graphic and put it in your NoaCG library. Runs nothing until a graphic is being made.

plugins.name: noacg-mcp
plugins.description: Optional: the NoaCG CLI as an always-on MCP server - one tool, noacg, with the CLI's verbs and a browser kept warm between calls. Install beside noacg when you want the tool in every session; it costs a process and some context in each.
